summary: Describes antsibull-changelog, which adds breaking_changes, security_fixes and trivial fragment categories and generates the changelog.yaml used for the combined CHANGELOG.rst and porting guide. Maintainers set each collection's changelog policy.
questions: What changelog fragment categories does antsibull-changelog add?
What is the changelog.yaml file used for?
Who decides the changelog rules for a collection?

answer_card.title: About antsibull-changelog
answer_card.answer_md: `antsibull-changelog` adds fragment categories `breaking_changes`, `security_fixes` and `trivial`, and generates `changelog.yaml`, which Ansible uses to build the combined `CHANGELOG.rst` and the Porting Guide. Each collection's maintainers set its changelog policy.
